run_mcp_responses_examples: run all MCP tool examples with the OpenAI Responses API client
create_response_no_filter: create a response using all MCP tools without any allowed_tools filter
create_response_wildcard: create a response allowing all MCP tools using wildcard in allowed_tools
create_response_specific_tools: create a response filtering MCP tools to only the search sub-tool
create_response_object_format: create a response using object format allowed_tools with tool_names and read_only fields
